jobs.title: Praktikum im Bereich Kommunikation - European Film Market
jobs.reason: This is an internship (Praktikum), which is excluded by policy; it is also explicitly a mandatory/study-accompanying placement requiring current enrolment in a digital-marketing programme, neither of which the candidate meets. The comms/social-media film-market focus is also outside all core interest zones.

jobs.title: Projektmanager:in Quartiersentwicklung (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: The role requires project-management experience from at least three projects or five years of relevant work, which the candidate's student-assistant background does not meet — an unmet essential experience threshold. It is also cultural/museum quarter-development work well outside the candidate's interest zones.
